apps.name: Symbios Settings
apps.subtitle: Halcyon Symbios settings over BLE
apps.localizedDescription: Read and change the settings of the Halcyon Symbios dive computer over Bluetooth LE (reverse-engineered). Grouped settings, gas-table editor (Nx/Trimix), timeouts & alarms, custom-fields editor, settings profiles + auto-backup, offline-draft mode. Physical iPhone only (the Simulator has no BLE).
apps.versionDescription: Custom-fields editor (CF Content screen): 22 toggle fields mapped to bytes 48/53/63. Online + offline-draft.

versions.localizedDescription: Custom-fields editor (CF Content screen): 22 toggle fields mapped to bytes 48/53/63. Online + offline-draft.
Offline draft mode: edit all settings incl. gases without a connection, save as a profile, apply later.
First release: read/change settings, gas editor (Nx/Trimix, presets), timeouts & alarms, settings profiles + auto-backup.

permissions.usageDescription: Connects to the Halcyon Symbios over Bluetooth LE.
